findings.title: Interactive elements give no hover feedback
findings.evidence: 4/12 distinct controls did not change on hover: Drift, How it works, Get Drift, Monthly.
findings.fix: Every link/button needs a state change: buttons lift 1–2px or shift background with a 160–240ms ease-out transition and a pressed scale(.97); text links animate an underline (scaleX 0→1 from the left); cards raise shadow and scale media 1.03.

findings.title: Text contrast is too low
findings.evidence: 4/37 checked text elements fail WCAG AA, e.g. "*Illustrative figures from an internal p" 4.07:1, "Testimonials are illustrative sample sto" 4.07:1, "© 2026 Drift Sleep Labs. A concept brand" 4.36:1.
findings.fix: Muted text still needs ≥4.5:1 (≥3:1 for 24px+). Raise lightness contrast of secondary text instead of lowering opacity.

findings.title: Entrance sequence is long
findings.fix: Keep the hero sequence ≲1.6 s from first paint to settled; shorten delays rather than durations. Visitors should be able to read the headline within ~600 ms.

findings.title: Layout properties are animated
findings.evidence: 1338 animations/transitions on height, width, top; 23871 inline-style layout writes.
findings.fix: Animate transform and opacity (and clip-path for reveals) instead of width/height/top/left/margin; they run on the compositor and avoid reflow jank. For accordions use grid-template-rows 0fr→1fr or measure once and animate a scale/clip.

findings.title: Many elements loop forever
findings.fix: Limit ambient loops to one or two focal elements (a hero visual, a marquee). Constant motion everywhere competes with content and drains battery; pause off-screen loops.

findings.title: Tap targets are small on mobile
findings.evidence: section#hero > a.scroll-hint 22×36, footer.footer > div.wrap.foot-grid > div > a 160×30, footer.footer > div.wrap.foot-grid > div > a 160×30, footer.footer > div.wrap.foot-grid > div > a 160×30
findings.fix: Give touch controls at least 44×44px of hit area (padding or a pseudo-element hit box).

findings.title: Body text is small on mobile
Some sections are static
findings.fix: Consider a subtle reveal for these sections so the page keeps a consistent rhythm, or keep them deliberately calm if they are dense reading areas.
